messages:
Ava: Quick sync idea 1: run a 30-person Design Partner pilot but recruit by psychographic segment: product builders, infra/ops teams, and cost-focused teams. goal: detect different success metrics and feature asks across mindsets, not just company size.
Diego: Love that. Suggest 3 screener qs to tag psychographic signals (30s). target ~10 per segment for v1.
Maya: For incentives let's A/B two variants: 4 hours premium support vs $500 credit. track which yields more active feedback.
Jordan: Ops cohort needs a step-by-step infra guide and an optional 1:1 bootcamp. product cohort gets prompt templates and eval recipes.
Priya: We'll need a short legal consent snippet for data use & incentive terms. I can draft a 2-line clause and checkbox text.
Ava: Proposed success metrics (quick): product: 80% run first integration + 1 feedback session within 14 days. ops: perf baseline + infra notes from >=30%. cost: at least 50% adopt Optimize suggestions with measurable token-cost delta.
Diego: Measurement plan: activation funnel, onboarding_complete_ts, #feedback sessions, 30d NPS, and qualitative tags (integration blocker, request type). I'll prepare metric tags and a tiny CSV schema.
Maya: Recruitment messaging: test "impact" vs "efficiency" subject lines. A/B invite and measure open->accept->activate.
Jordan: Onboard checklist (automatable):
1) issue API key + sample call
2) perf test (10 requests) auto-upload results
3) join cohort slack
4) schedule feedback session
Can we automate #2 and push to a dashboard?
Sam: Ops capacity: we can support 30 but stagger starts across 3 weeks to smooth 1:1s. recommend weekly waves of 10.
Priya: I'll confirm credit accounting and post legal blurb. need to ensure anonymized logs are OK for research.
Ava: Next steps: Diego drafts screener + metrics tags; Maya writes two invite copy variants; Priya legal blurb; Jordan builds small onboard automation for perf tests; Sam schedules cohort windows. I'll assemble rollout calendar and success criteria doc.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: add cohort to dp-beta-queue and auto-tag segment label on screener pass. :robot_face:
Maya: Also request: expose psychographic segment as a filter in the evaluation dashboard so PMs can slice feedback by mindset.
Diego: I'll include sample CSV fields: participant_id, segment, accept_ts, onboarding_complete_ts, perf_avg_latency_ms, tokens_per_call, feedback_sessions_count, nps_30. will paste a tiny JSON example in the doc.
Ava: Cool. If no objections I'll start outreach next Tuesday and run the first 10-wave then. :thumbsup:
